जुटक nf. (टकं-टिका)
 1. The matted hair of ŚIVA or of ascetics.
 2. Any
knot or fillet of hair.
 E. जट् to collect, affix अच्, and सज्ञायां कन्
पृषो० or ऊ inserted; see जटा; also जूट, जूटक’ &c.

जूट m. (टः)
 1. The matted hair of Ś

. The clotted hair of an as-
cetic.
 E. जट् to collect, affix अच्, ऊ inserted; see जटा;
[]
also with कन् added जूटक.
 n. (-कं) and with a short vowel जुटक q.
v.; it is also used compounded with जटा in the same sense, as
जटाजूट.
